findings.summary: The badpath prefix check uses startswith(base) without a trailing separator (also at lines 262, 337 and near 106 in the tar version), so archive members can escape into sibling directories like /tmp/out_evil, which weakens path-traversal protection.

badlink in SevenZipExtractor.safemembers is defined but never called because the symlink branch is commented out (same in the zip version), leaving dead, misleading code and no symlink check of its own.
The tar safemembers parameter is annotated as tarfile.TarFile but is actually an iterable of TarInfo, which is inconsistent with the other extractors and will trigger type-checker errors.
